Class EliteEnemyShip

java.lang.Object
com.r3m.spaceshooter.entity.Spaceship
com.r3m.spaceshooter.entity.EnemySpaceship
com.r3m.spaceshooter.entity.EliteEnemyShip
public class EliteEnemyShip extends EnemySpaceship
A faster, more precise enemy type: only fires when it's actually lined up with the player (no random pot-shots), but reloads quicker and closes the distance faster than a grunt — a sharper, more deliberate threat rather than a spray-and-pray one.

      Description copied from class: Spaceship
